7-Zip application

/Applications/7-Zip.appnative GUI application
  ↳ 7ZipQuickLook.appexQuick Look archive preview

The application supplies a Finder context menu with “Compress with 7-Zip” and “Extract with 7-Zip”, and archive previews when you press Space on an archive.

Removing

Run sudo sh /usr/local/share/doc/7zip/uninstall.sh to remove every file this package installed, including the application and its Quick Look extension.

Note

This package is ad-hoc signed but not notarized by Apple. If macOS blocks an installed executable, clear the quarantine attribute with:

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /usr/local/bin/7zz
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/7-Zip.app
